Metadata.title: Medilog — Smart Medical Records Platform
Metadata.description: Medilog is a smart medical records platform for managing patient files, appointments, visits, and prescriptions securely.

Home.title: Everything about your patient, in one place.
Home.description: Medilog is a smart medical platform that helps doctors and clinics manage records, appointments, visits, and prescriptions with ease and confidence.
Home.proof: Trusted by modern doctors and clinics
Home.featuresDescription: Medilog gives you a clearer view and better control over every part of the patient journey.

featuresList.title: Organized records
featuresList.description: Keep medical history, diagnoses, and prescriptions in one clear profile.

featuresList.title: Effortless scheduling
featuresList.description: Organize your calendar and keep a quick view of every patient's visit.

featuresList.title: Data-led decisions
featuresList.description: Track your clinic activity and uncover insights that help you grow.

featuresList.title: One connected team
featuresList.description: Give your team the right tools for a smoother care experience.

Home.workflowDescription: From the first appointment to follow-up, every step is organized so you can focus on what matters.

workflow.title: Add patient details
workflow.description: Create an organized medical profile in seconds.

workflow.title: Record the visit
workflow.description: Document diagnoses, prescriptions, and notes in one place.

workflow.title: Track progress
workflow.description: Return to a clear timeline and make better decisions.

Home.securityTitle: Your patients' data is always protected
Home.securityDescription: Privacy and security are at the heart of the experience, so you can work with confidence.
securityPoints: A timeline that's easy to review
Home.storyEyebrow: Real experiences, even when starting small
Home.storyTitle: Made for the busy clinic day
Home.storyDescription: Every detail in Medilog is designed to make your day calmer and give you more time to focus on patients.

testimonials.quote: I can see the patient's full history before the visit starts, without searching through scattered files.
testimonials.name: Dr. Sarah Khaled

testimonials.quote: Organizing appointments and daily follow-ups saved our team hours of calls and coordination.
testimonials.name: Mona Ali

testimonials.quote: The interface is clear and fast, and sensitive information stays visible only to the right person.
testimonials.name: Dr. Omar Hassan

Home.ctaDescription: Organize your day, understand your data, and deliver better care with Medilog.

Footer.description: A smart platform for organizing medical records and managing the patient journey with confidence.

meta.title: Medical records
meta.description: Record a visit, its diagnoses and its prescribed medications for your patients.

workspace.title: Medical records
workspace.description: Open a visit to review its clinical content and keep it up to date.
workspace.openVisitHint: Paste the identifier of the visit you want to review.
workspace.tokenRequired: Add a development token before opening a visit.

token.title: Development token
token.description: Paste a JWT created with the 'dotnet user-jwts' command. It is kept in this browser tab only, is never logged, and this panel is hidden in production builds.
token.label: Bearer token
token.storageFailed: This browser blocked storage, so the token could not be saved.

visit.title: Visit details
visit.readOnlyNote: The patient and the appointment link cannot be changed after the visit is created.

visitForm.createDescription: Document the consultation for a patient in your workspace. The patient identifier is required.
visitForm.patientIdHint: The patient must belong to your workspace.
visitForm.appointmentIdHint: Leave empty when the visit is not linked to an appointment.
visitForm.readOnlyNote: The patient and the appointment link stay unchanged.

diagnosis.title: Diagnoses
diagnosis.description: The conditions recorded during this visit.
diagnosis.emptyDescription: Add the first diagnosis for this visit.

medication.title: Medications
medication.description: The prescription recorded for this visit.
medication.emptyDescription: Add the first medication line for this visit.
medication.deleteDescription: This permanently removes the line from the prescription. It cannot be undone.

states.tokenDescription: Open this record after adding a development token in the medical-records workspace.
states.tokenRequiredNotice: Add a development token to save this visit.
states.unauthorizedDescription: The token is missing or expired. Add a valid development token and try again.
states.forbiddenDescription: You do not have access to this patient record.
states.notFoundDescription: This visit does not exist or is outside your workspace.
states.networkDescription: Check the API address and your connection, then try again.
states.serverDescription: The server could not complete the request. Please try again.

errors.unauthorized: Your session is not valid. Add a valid development token and try again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have access to this patient record.
errors.notFound: This visit does not exist or is outside your workspace.
errors.conflict: This appointment is already linked to another visit.
errors.network: The server is unreachable. Check your connection and try again.
errors.server: Something went wrong. Please try again.

validation.visitDateRequired: Enter the visit date and time.
validation.visitDateInvalid: Enter a valid visit date and time.
validation.visitDateFuture: The visit date cannot be in the future.
validation.diagnosisDateFuture: The diagnosis date cannot be in the future.
validation.frequencyRequired: Enter how often the medication is taken.
validation.maxLength: This field must be at most {max} characters.

notifications.saveFailed: The visit could not be saved.
notifications.diagnosisSaveFailed: The diagnosis could not be saved.
notifications.medicationSaveFailed: The medication could not be saved.
notifications.medicationDeleteFailed: The medication could not be deleted.

NotFound.description: The page you are looking for could not be found.
